literal: She blessed me; I sneezed; immediately, breaking down, she wept, saying, 'Thinking of whom did you sneeze?'
translation: She blessed me when I sneezed, but immediately changed her mood and wept, asking, 'Thinking of which other woman did you sneeze?'
modern: நான் தும்மியபோது அவள் என்னை வாழ்த்தினாள்; ஆனால் உடனே தன் மனநிலையை மாற்றிக்கொண்டு, 'யாரை நினைத்துக் கொண்டு தும்மினீர்?' என்று கேட்டு அழுதுவிட்டாள்.
explanation: This couplet portrays a playful lover's tiff based on a traditional belief. In Tamil culture, a sneeze is believed to occur when someone is thinking of you, and it is customary to bless the person who sneezes. When the hero sneezes, the heroine instinctively blesses him out of love. However, she immediately realizes the implication of the sneeze: someone else must have been thinking of him. Suspecting that another woman was remembering her lover, she breaks down in tears and demands to know who that woman is.
